current short videos (which work) and the longer video I mentioned show
warnings for variable frame rate and overall re-encoding. We’ve also seen
the reverse cases, where videos without any warnings still fail. The only
factor that seems to matter is the size/length of the video, but even there
the exact threshold isn’t clear.

What would be the best way to share videos with you? They are quite large
in size. Would it be possible to add you to the Encord dataset somehow?

subject: Re: Pixellot + Encord
text:
Hi,

On our agent side we fetch frames using the dep_single_frame dependency
into our FastAPI endpoint:

app = get_encord_app()

@app.post("/detect_objects/{model_type}/{model_name}", status_code=status.
HTTP_200_OK)
async def detect_objects(
    model_type: str,
    model_name: str,
    frame_data: FrameData,
    label_row: Annotated[LabelRowV2, Depends(dep_label_row)],
    content: Annotated[NDArray[np.uint8], Depends(dep_single_frame)],
):
    logger.info(f"{model_type} model detection request: {model_name}")
    logger.info(f"frame: {frame_data.frame}")
    logger.info(f"frame content shape: {content.shape}")

When it works, we see the following logs. The frame is fetched
successfully, inference runs, and bounding boxes are uploaded back into
Encord:
*Logs:*

*INFO:encord.http.querier:Request: {"query_type": "labelrowmetadata",
...}INFO:encord.http.querier:Request: {"query_type": "labelrow",
...}  INFO:root:<type> model detection request: <name>INFO:root:frame:
0INFO:root:frame content shape: (900, 3840, 3)*

When it fails, we see the initial metadata and labelrow fetch in the logs,
but our endpoint is never reached (no frame number or shape is logged).
Based on this behavior, it looks like the request doesn’t make it past
frame extraction (dep_single_frame) for certain videos. In the Encord UI
this shows up as *service unavailable*:

*Logs:INFO:encord.http.querier:Request: {"query_type": "labelrowmetadata",
...}INFO:encord.http.querier:Request: {"query_type": "labelrow", ...}*

This behavior is reproducible in dataset
2ecb091d-6c12-402f-a72a-1ec2a00cd420. The shorter videos work fine, but the
longer one consistently fails as described above.
